text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report recommends the installation of no standing zones on both sides of Collingsbrook Boulevard, between Bridletowne Circle and Solway Court. Currently, there is a curve west of Bridletowne Circle and parking is permitted for a maximum period of three hours on both sides of Collingsbrook Boulevard, between Bridletowne Circle and Timbercreek Court/Ridgecrest Drive.
Scarborough Community Council: 1. Prohibited standing at all times on both sides of Collingsbrook Boulevard, between Bridletowne Circle and Solway Court.
